title: game/light.json
description: The light round the player (I05b, inventory-plan 3.8): how the light stat becomes a reach and a strength, the light's colour, and the daylight it fades between. Loaded by PlayerLightData (Vocaterra.Game.Core), which also checks the ranges and the order of the thresholds.

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

radiusBase.description: The reach, in blocks, of the faintest light.

radiusPerPoint.description: The blocks of reach each point of the light stat adds.

strengthPerPoint.description: The strength each point of the light stat adds, before maxStrength.

maxStrength.description: The strongest the light gets (the share of a face's colour added next to the player).

darkAtDaylight.description: At or under this share of daylight at the player the light is at full strength.

offAtDaylight.description: At or over this share of daylight the light is off; above darkAtDaylight.
